string.text: Well... oh! I don't even know if you've ever held a piece like this... An upgraded Kalash! More specifically, an AK-105: 45-round magazine and a rail for foreign optics! I remember trading it off a Duty member for medkits. Freedom had really done a number on their squad back then — the Duty guys didn't have enough supplies of their own... After that, this gun saved my life three times... Yeah, this one's definitely mine!
Here, a FNX-45 pistol! Great piece. That'll be another 2800 from you.
Here, the FNX-45! Another 2800 from you.
Take a look — a Desert Eagle, comes with a red dot sight and a compensator. Lethal thing! The remaining 2800 and it's yours.
Here — a Desert Eagle, with a red dot sight and compensator. A deadly pistol! Heavy though, I won't lie... The remaining 2800 and it's yours.
A SIG Sauer P320 chambered in .45 ACP. Produced in a small batch on order for an unknown special forces unit. The remaining 2800 and it's yours.
Here, a SIG P320 in .45 ACP. Another 2800 from you.
I believe this is exactly what you need. A PKP Pecheneg! 42000 and take it.
Of course. A PKP Pecheneg. For 42000.
Here it is: an M60 machine gun, a Vietnam veteran!... But this one is new, don't worry! Well, 42,000 - and it's yours.
Of course. Here it is: the M60, nicknamed "the pig" by the Americans for its shortcomings and appearance, heh... The missing 42,000 and it's yours.
I think this is exactly what you need. A German HK21E! 42,000 and take it.
Of course. HK21E. For 42,000.
Here, an M4, in a tactical configuration. For 16000 this beauty is yours.
Here, an M4. That'll be 16000 from you.
Here, an OTs-14 Groza in 5.45. For 16000 this beauty is yours.
Here, an OTs-14 Groza chambered in 5.45. That'll be 16000 from you.
Here: a VSS Vintorez, with a tactical grip and a cheek rest on the stock for comfortable aiming. Another 16000.
Of course. Here: a VSS Vintorez, tactical configuration. For the remaining 16000.
Here you go — an L96A1, known in these parts as the AWP. Don't ask where I got it... Another 32000 from you.
Yep. The L96A1 — a sniper rifle. Another 32000 from you.
One second! Here, an VSSK "Vykhlop"! Another 28000 from you.
Here: an sniper rifle VSSK "Vykhlop". Another 28000 from you.
Here: a Barrett M98 Bravo! Look how massive it is... Well, 28000 and it's yours.
Of course. Here: a Barrett M98 Bravo, serious piece of kit... The remaining 28000 and it's yours.
A machine gun.
No problem. That'll cost you 44000, and I'll need 2000 upfront.
You backed out of the last order... So this one will cost you 26000, and I'll need 4000 upfront.
Tactical weapons.
Tactical? Well, I've got something in mind... Standard price is 20000, with 4000 as a deposit. So, what do you say?
I can get it for 36000, but 4000 of that will need to be paid in advance.
